title: Nintendo Wii : Charm Girls Club: Pajama Party Video Games Complete
descriptionText:
Get ready for a fun-filled night with Charm Girls Club: Pajama Party for Nintendo Wii. This action and adventure game is perfect for all ages and features the popular Charm Girls Club series. With Electronic Arts as the publisher, you know this game is sure to provide hours of entertainment. 

Join the girls in their pajamas and get ready for a wild adventure. This game is complete with all the necessary components for a great gaming experience. Immerse yourself in the world of Charm Girls Club and enjoy the excitement of Pajama Party.
